Evidence: Interim success, 10 wins in 12, full-time talks
#Aletheia #AFL

The reality matches the claim perfectly. Fraser has transformed Carlton's season through simplicity and player empowerment, while maintaining absolute humility and focus on the team.

Following Michael Voss's departure, interim coach Josh Fraser has guided Carlton to 10 wins from 12 games. As fans demand his permanent appointment, Fraser remains focused on upcoming matches.

Fraser's refusal to self-promote protects the team from media distraction during a critical finals run, demonstrating elite organizational stewardship.

The Unavoidable Lie: You must constantly campaign for your own advancement to be considered for it.
